name: Wahlsburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wahlsburg (a white column on red and white horseshoe-shaped brackets on green).
history: The flag was approved for the municipality together with the arms, showing them on a red, white and green striped cloth. A former municipality: Wahlsburg merged with Oberweser into the municipality of Wesertal on 1 January 2020.
